pr_title: tree: add a case for enums in AsJSON
pr_body:
Fixes #50524.

This commit fixes an assertion failure by adding a case for enum types
in the `tree.AsJSON` function.

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/50547)
